_doc: 16 Mission Brief (Chance) + 16 Senate Dispatch (Community Chest) cards. Opcodes and params are the classic post-2008 US card set (COMMUNITY/SECONDARY per docs/classic_monopoly_structure.md 5.1, CARD-SEC) and must stay stable; only text is theme data. Targets are board indices.

chance.text: Recalled to the Launch Bay. Advance to Launch Bay and collect $200.
Summoned to court. Advance to Centauri Imperial Court.
Escort duty. Advance to Rhea Bastion. If you pass Launch Bay, collect $200.
Survey mission. Advance to Olympus Habitat. If you pass Launch Bay, collect $200.
Take a trip through Porta Mercurii Jump Gate. If you pass Launch Bay, collect $200.
Advance to the nearest Jump Gate. If owned, pay the owner twice the toll. If unclaimed, you may buy it.
Advance to the nearest Jump Gate. If owned, pay the owner twice the toll. If unclaimed, you may buy it.
Advance to the nearest power or water plant. If owned, roll the dice and pay the owner 10 times the roll. If unclaimed, you may buy it.
The Imperial Treasury pays you a dividend of $50.
Imperial Pardon. Leave the Brig free. Keep this card until needed or traded.
Report to the Brig. Go directly to the Brig. Do not pass Launch Bay, do not collect $200.
Hull maintenance on all your holdings: pay $25 per outpost module and $100 per citadel.
Speeding in a shipping lane. Fine $15.
Elected Consul of the Fleet. Pay each player $50.

community_chest.text: The Senate recalls you. Advance to Launch Bay and collect $200.
Treasury ledger error in your favour. Collect $200.
Senatorial Pardon. Leave the Brig free. Keep this card until needed or traded.
Report to the Brig. Go directly to the Brig. Do not pass Launch Bay, do not collect $200.
It is your naming day. Collect $10 from every player.
Habitat repairs assessed: pay $40 per outpost module and $115 per citadel.
Second prize in the Senate pageant. Collect $10.
You inherit an ancestral estate. Collect $100.
